results.content: Quantum-enhanced long short-term memory with attention for spatial permeability prediction in oilfield reservoirs. For the first time in subsurface spatial prediction, this study presents a quantum-enhanced long short-term memory with attention (QLSTMA) model that incorporates variational quantum circuits (VQCs) into the recurrent cell. To address these challenges, this study introduces the Quantum-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory with Attention (QLSTMA), a novel hybrid quantum-classical neural network designed specifically for spatial permeability prediction. The QLSTMA model integrates variational quantum circuits (VQCs) into the core LSTM architecture, leveraging quantum principles such as superposition and entanglement to enhance feature representation and model expressiveness. The QLSTMA model is built upon a hybrid quantum-classical framework that combines the sequential modeling strength of LSTM networks with the high-dimensional representational power of quantum circuits. The integration of quantum circuits into the LSTM framework not only improves predictive accuracy but also reduces the overall number of trainable parameters, making the model computationally efficient despite its enhanced complexity.
